verdict.rationale: AgentMail hosts a live llms.txt file (verified HTTP 200) with a clear agent-oriented summary of its docs, and its entire documentation set is written in agent-consumable .md format (e.g., quickstart.md, messages.md) alongside an OpenAPI spec, MCP server, and CLI docs, making it easy for an agent to be pointed at and consume its docs. Missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation of an agent successfully navigating llms.txt end-to-end.
